Max out Oak Sage instead of Volcano for increased survivability. Put additional points into Summon Dire Wolf for more Summon Grizzly Life if you have any left over.

source_variant_flags.name: Starter
source_variant_flags.purpose: The Starter variant meets the minimum gear requirements for farming the Starter tagged areas; most of this gear can be acquired by early Nightmare with a standard progression.

Weapon-Swap: Staff of Teleportation (planner: magic Battle Staff, Teleport charges, 40 Fire Res)
Harmony (prose: 'You can also use a Harmony for faster travel')
Gloves: Magic Heavy Gloves 30 Fire Resist / 25% MF
Belt: Caster Crafted Belt 'Cruel Clasp' Sharkskin Belt (10% FCR, 9 Str, 20 Mana, 10% Mana Regen, 10 Cold-Light-Fire Res)
Other: Lower Resist Charge Wand kept in inventory and/or Horadric Cube (recharge with Gold or Chipped Gem + Ort Rune cube recipe)

source_quotes: Prioritize Resistances, + to Skills, Life, and Magic Find stats on your gear. Use a Staff of Teleportation on Weapon-Swap to reposition. You can also use a Harmony for faster travel. Keep a Lower Resist Charge Wand in your inventory and/or Horadric Cube to break monster Fire Immunity/lower monster Fire Resistances if necessary.

Early-game Helmet/Body Armor options for these stats include, but are not limited to, Bulwark, Undead Crown, Rockstopper, Smoke, Treachery, Duriel's Shell, or simply Helmet and Body Armor Bases socketed with Ral Runes, Ort Runes, and Thul Runes.
